title: Corporeal
description: More realistic needs and movement mechanics.
body:
Corporeal adds realistic movement, running speed, and block breaking speed. Jumping after sneaking will let you vault up 2 blocks, and sneaking will dampen your fall from low heights. Lack of sleep is now penalized after over a day without sleep, and you now prefer to have a roof over your bed when you sleep. Total work done each day is tracked, and can make you exhausted. 

Made as a part of [LITHIC](https://modrinth.com/datapack/lithic)
